queue_row_numbering: one-based data-row order, excluding the CSV header
viewing_method: eight generated contact sheets with derived fire boxes rendered in red at original sheet resolution

classification_definitions.acceptable: visible fire is plausibly covered by the rendered box or the background image correctly contains no localized fire target
classification_definitions.questionable: a label may cover smoke, graphics, a boundary artifact, an ambiguous tiny target, or cannot be judged reliably at contact-sheet resolution
classification_definitions.incorrect: no visible fire is covered by the rendered box at contact-sheet resolution

interpretation: The queue is deterministic and stratified by split and smallest normalized box area; it is not a simple random prevalence sample.
Eighteen ambiguous records require full-resolution adjudication before the curated manifest can be frozen.
Single-reviewer judgments do not establish whole-dataset label-error prevalence.
